evidence.observation: The mapping marks '`reference_populations`, sample populations | none in the ontology; mappings are layer 1 | out of scope'. `reference_populations` is a top-level field in the GND model schema, while predicate 3 promises a disposition for every model element and predicate 5 promises an equal round trip.

concerns.recommendation: Give these fields an explicit extension or refusal disposition and specify how round-trip equality handles them.
concerns.title: Model populations fall outside the disposition and round-trip contracts

evidence.observation: The CLI makes the report optional in '`gnd export ossie MODEL --out FILE [--loss-report FILE]`', while OD6 says 'Exit 0 with the loss report' when constructs are refused. No default report destination is specified.

concerns.recommendation: Specify a guaranteed report destination or require an explicit report path whenever export succeeds with a refused disposition; fail if the report cannot be written.
concerns.title: A successful lossy export may have no visible loss report

evidence.observation: Predicate 3 requires 'Every model element has exactly one disposition', but the mapping assigns 'native + extension' to one row and 'requires/extension' to others. It does not define whether dispositions apply to whole objects or individual fields.

concerns.recommendation: Define the unit of disposition and represent native/formula output plus extension-preserved fields without assigning conflicting statuses; test field-level coverage in the census.
concerns.title: The disposition rule cannot represent the proposed mixed mappings

evidence.observation: Predicate 9 requires that an upstream contribution 'has been opened', but OS6 says 'It does not block the close: if the PR is still open at close, its state is recorded as a carryover.' The phase graph also places OS6 before close.

concerns.recommendation: State whether an opened PR is mandatory for close, and distinguish an open PR from a PR that has not been posted because its separate owner gate has not been granted.
concerns.title: OS6 has conflicting milestone close criteria

response.summary: The plan needs a consistent loss-report contract, complete treatment of model fields, and a clear OS6 close criterion.
